annotations.title: Append Markdown to a Zotero note

description: Add Markdown to the end of an existing Zotero note, keeping everything already in it, including its own citations and formatting. Markdown: headings, paragraphs, bullet and numbered lists, **bold**, *italic*, ~~strikethrough~~, `code` and fenced code blocks, [links](https://...), > blockquotes, tables, horizontal rules, and $inline$ or $$display$$ math, all stored as the note editor's own HTML. Raw HTML is shown as text, not interpreted. Cite a library item with its key in brackets: [@ABCD2345], [@ABCD2345, p. 12], [see @ABCD2345; @WXYZ6789, pp. 3-5]. Each becomes a real Zotero citation (clickable in Zotero, live when the note is added to a Word document), and a key that names nothing refuses the write. `note_key` is the note's own key (zotero_get_item with include_children lists an item's notes). To start a new note use zotero_create_note; to rewrite one, zotero_replace_note. If someone edits the note at the same moment, it is re-read and the text appended to the fresh copy. Writes go to the running Zotero desktop app (Zotero 10+) for every library it holds, otherwise to the cloud Web API.

cite.description: Turn [@ITEMKEY] references into Zotero citations (default true). false leaves them as plain text.

library_id.description: Numeric id of the library to address, e.g. 5234875 for a group (zotero_groups lists the ids you can reach). Omit to use the configured default library; an id given without library_type is read as a group id.

library_type.description: Which library to address: "user" (a personal library) or "group" (a shared group library). Omit to use the library this server is configured for. "group" on its own is refused: pass library_id with it.

markdown.description: What to add at the end of the note, in Markdown.

note_key.description: Key of the note to append to.

name: zotero_append_to_note

citations.description: How many [@KEY] groups in the appended text became Zotero citations.

newVersion.description: The note's version after the write.

note_key.description: The note this call appended to.

retried.description: True when a version conflict made it re-read the note and append to the fresh copy.

target.description: Where the write went: "local" (Zotero desktop local API), "desktop" (connector protocol) or "cloud" (Zotero Web API).
